venue.details: Big Seminar Room in the first floor. Follow the signs to enter the venue

items.information:
##### *English version is below*

#### **Deutsch:**

Nach einem erfolgreichem Fasching Turnier im letzten Jahr, dürfen wir auch dieses Jahr wieder Vienna Fasching 2024 als offizelles WCA Turnier ankündigen.

Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von David Dinh, Jeremia Neuhold, Lucas Höglinger und delegiert von Viktor Kalmar und Pranjal Khan. Diesmal findet die Competition im Jugendgästehaus Brigittenau statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt.

Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen!

Jeder Teilnehmer darf einen Gast mitbringen.


Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich!

-----

#### **English:**

After a successful Fasching Competition last year, we are once again happy to announce Vienna Fasching 2024 as an official WCA Competition.

The speedcubing competition is organised by David Dinh, Jeremia Neuhold, Lucas Höglinger and delegated by Viktor Kalmar and Pranjal Khan. Results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings.

The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations.

Every Competitor can bring one guest.

The city of Valparaíso is gearing up to host a unique experience filled with speed, skill, and excitement in the second championship of the year dedicated to the fascinating world of the Rubik's Cube! The "Valparaíso Summer Open 2024" promises to be an unforgettable event for cube enthusiasts and those who wish to immerse themselves in the magic of puzzles with their different categories: 2x2, 3x3, 4x4, and Pyraminx!

venue.name: North Ballroom - University of Arizona Student Union
venue.details: Located on the 3rd floor of the Student Union

items.information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ArizonaFavorites2024#38770-competitor-responsibilities) tab.

#Please note that this is a "Favorites" style competition
Since this is a "Favorites" competition, you may choose at most four (4) events.  If you are unfamiliar with this style of a competition, please read the "[What is a Favorites Competition?](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ArizonaFavorites2024#38725-what-is-a-favorites-competition)" tab.  Due to the style of this competition, the schedule may change after registration has closed to allot the appropriate amount of time to each event based on registration numbers.  Due to scheduling so many events, we have a few events that overlap.  You can still register to compete in both events;  you will just do one event's solves and upon finishing, compete in the other event.
